dedupe_keys.name: natural risk maps and etat des risques for mayotte prefecture and dealm risk mapping site

description: In Mayotte, the French department in the Indian Ocean, the environment and planning directorate (DEALM) and the Prefecture run a website that maps natural risks by land parcel. The DEALM page read on 2026-09-28 explains that anyone selling or renting property must supply a statement of risks and pollution, and that the risk mapping website covers flooding, ground movement, earthquakes, marine submersion and coastline retreat, lets users select a parcel and download a partly pre-filled statement, and offers free downloads of the decrees prescribing and approving the natural and coastal risk prevention plans (PPRN and PPRL), their regulations and other hazard knowledge documents. Coverage is the island of Mayotte. Access is free; no licence is stated. Caveats: the address of the mapping website is not given on the page read and the hazard layers were not seen directly; zoning follows the plans in force, which may be older than recent events such as cyclone Chido in December 2024. It supports hazard exposure and adaptation studies of buildings, roads and utilities on Mayotte. No related Mayotte hazard record is catalogued; national Géorisques data complement it.
